rules.name: FORBIDDEN GROUND
rules.turn:
move P L, presence-of S P, spirit:special S forbidden-ground, land L, presence-count S L 1
  +creates-sacred-site S L P
spirit-phase, creates-sacred-site S L P, >move P L, ^sacred-site-created S L P, ~forbidden-ground S L
fast-phase, creates-sacred-site S L P, >move P L, ^sacred-site-created S L P, ~forbidden-ground S L
invader-phase, creates-sacred-site S L P, >move P L, ^sacred-site-created S L P, ~forbidden-ground S L
slow-phase, creates-sacred-site S L P, >move P L, ^sacred-site-created S L P, ~forbidden-ground S L
forbidden-ground S L, at D L, piece:kind D dahan, ~push S D L
rules.evidence: sacred-site-created keeper l3 k2; forbidden-ground keeper l3 (once); push keeper *127 l3 -> l2
rules.notes: 'After you create a Sacred Site' is a transition: the move that finds presence-count S L = 1 at its start creates it. The trigger needed a generic per-phase window (BASE-EXT `^phase`) plus a phase-scoped tag so it fires exactly once and is ordered before the next phase. Port to fresh-left `^`: the generic `^phase` window starts at its own moment inside each phase, incomparable with the move, so the trigger never fired; it is now one rule per phase, anchored on the phase episode and continuing after the move (`>move P L`).
rules.text: After you create a [Sacred Site] , Push all [Dahan] from that land.

rules.name: FORBIDDEN GROUND (Dahan Events)
rules.text: Dahan Events never move [Dahan] to your [Sacred Site] , but Powers can do so.
rules.turn:
push event D From, piece:kind D dahan, spirit:special K forbidden-ground,
  (push-to D C), !(not-sacred-site K C)
rules.evidence: Event pushes 3 Dahan out of l2 (adjacent l1, l3=Sacred Site): all 3 go to l1 in every seed
rules.notes: Narrows only the Event's push choice (named by push-to), so Powers are unaffected. Needed a 'not a Sacred Site' relation: done by adding a 0 row to presence-count (additive) and `lt N 2`, since acc has no negation. Events are modeled as the pusher `event`.

base_ext: presence-count 0 rows; not-sacred-site; Event as a push actor; the trigger written once per phase (spirit/fast/invader/slow-phase).
language_issues: `turn, >move P L` floats: it is after the move but unordered relative to the following phases, so effects can be invisible to the next phase; anchor triggers on a per-phase window instead.

`phase, >move P L` alone fires once per later phase (>p only requires p to end before the window ends); restricting to the phase the move happened in needed a phase-scoped tag: `phase, (move P L), ..., ^tag` then `phase, tag, >move P L`.
A head variable that is not bound in the body (I dropped S from the second rule) silently becomes a fresh object instead of an error (`forbidden-ground *8671 l3`).
'Not a Sacred Site' needs a complement; with no acc negation it is `presence-count S L N, lt N 2` plus explicit 0 rows.
